comments.body:
CI on this PR failed the TypeScript build with TS4053 (`Return type of public method from exported class has or is using name 'Output' ... cannot be named`) on the new `transformInput` override. Pushed a commit that gives the override the same explicit return type as `VercelChatModel.transformInput`. Anthropic adapter tests (12) and prettier pass locally.

This comment was drafted with Claude Code.
